description: This Kotlin source file defines the ContentRowAdapter class, an adapter for RecyclerView that renders a list of content rows, each with a title and a horizontally scrolling list of content cards. It includes focus handling to ensure the row title remains visible when navigating with a remote or keyboard.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for displaying a list of content rows, each with a title and a nested horizontal RecyclerView of content cards. Manages focus to keep titles visible.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual content rows, managing the title TextView and inner RecyclerView.

methods.name: ContentRowAdapter.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with a list of ContentRow objects and submits it to the adapter.

methods.name: ContentRowAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the item_content_row layout.

methods.name: ContentRowAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH.bind
methods.description: Binds a ContentRow to the ViewHolder, setting the title text and configuring the inner RecyclerView with layout, adapter, and focus behavior.
